import mir_eval

# Align and convert frequencies to cents and voicing arrays
ref_v, ref_c, est_v, est_c = mir_eval.melody.to_cent_voicing(
    times, ref_freqs, times, est_freqs
)

# Compute raw chroma accuracy
raw_chroma = mir_eval.melody.raw_chroma_accuracy(ref_v, ref_c, est_v, est_c)

# Compute raw pitch accuracy for invariant testing
raw_pitch = mir_eval.melody.raw_pitch_accuracy(ref_v, ref_c, est_v, est_c)

# Invariant: Since raw_chroma_accuracy ignores octave errors, 
# it must be greater than or equal to raw_pitch_accuracy.
assert raw_chroma >= raw_pitch, f"Chroma accuracy {raw_chroma} must be >= pitch accuracy {raw_pitch}"
assert 0.0 <= raw_chroma <= 1.0, "Accuracy must be bounded between 0 and 1"

print(f"__CHECK__ raw_chroma_accuracy {raw_chroma}")
